# Next Level Procurement

> Smarter Buying, Delivering Value. A procurement and sourcing partner that buys, ships and delivers for businesses and individuals, from the UK, China, Europe, Turkey and Africa to wherever the client is.

## Services
- [Purchasing and sourcing](https://nextlevelprocurements.com/services/purchasing-and-sourcing): from anywhere in the world to anywhere, including importation from China.
- [UK personal shopping](https://nextlevelprocurements.com/services/uk-personal-shopping): for clients abroad who want to buy from UK shops and have it sent to their country.
- [Consumables supply](https://nextlevelprocurements.com/services/consumables-supply): basic consumables for businesses and individuals, such as bin bags, microfibre cloths, disposable gloves and disposable napkins.
- [Made in China StarterKit](https://nextlevelprocurements.com/starter-kit): training on how to import from China ($20).

## Where we buy from
